Perplexity subscribers who work in design can now add a Canva connector to the Computer platform, allowing Perplexity’s desktop agent to autonomously turn data and prompts into editable Canva assets. Here are the details.

Canva connector now available on Perplexity Computer

If you’re not familiar with Perplexity Computer, it is a Mac-native platform that serves as the user’s personal agentic assistant and performs tasks across local and cloud environments.

In practice, users can connect Perplexity Computer to hundreds of platforms they already use, such as Notion, Google Drive, GitHub, SharePoint, and beyond, and then have Perplexity’s agents perform tasks on their behalf.

This week, Canva launched a Perplexity Computer connector, which means the platform’s agents can now work directly inside Canva to create assets based on the user’s requests and needs.

The new Canva connector is available for Perplexity Pro, Max, Enterprise Pro, and Enterprise Max users. To learn more about it, follow this link, or click here to learn more about Perplexity Computer connectors.
